# QIP archive

> Static copies of the websites of past Quantum Information Processing (QIP) conferences, 1998–2026, preserved by the International Association for Quantum Information (IAQI). Pages are archived as they were published; programs, accepted papers, abstracts and slides are mostly in HTML and PDF.

The current conference is at https://qipconference.org/. For structured, machine-readable data (talks, posters, authors with ORCID, committees, videos) use QuantumDB, which covers the same conferences: https://quantumdb.iaqi.org/llms.txt (data under CC0 1.0).

## Structured data (recommended for agents)

- [All conferences, with links to every per-year export](https://quantumdb.iaqi.org/api/v1/export/all.json)
- One conference as JSON: `https://quantumdb.iaqi.org/api/v1/export/conferences/qip-<year>`; CSV: append `/talks.csv`, `/posters.csv` or `/committees.csv`
- [QuantumDB guide for LLMs](https://quantumdb.iaqi.org/llms.txt)

## Archived editions

### QIP 2026

2026-01-26 to 2026-01-30; Riga, Latvia

- [Archived website](https://qip.iaqi.org/2026/)

- [Detailed schedule](https://qip.iaqi.org/2026/programme/detailed-schedule/)
- [Accepted Papers](https://qip.iaqi.org/2026/programme/accepted-papers/)
- [Invited Speakers](https://qip.iaqi.org/2026/programme/invited-speakers/)
- [Steering Committee](https://qip.iaqi.org/2026/about/steering-committee/)

## Rights

Facts about the conferences (titles, authors, dates) are free to use; QuantumDB dedicates its data to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Abstracts, slides, photos and recordings remain the property of their authors.
